> help

Enter a mathematical expression or a command and press enter.
Complete functions, units and variables with the tabulator key.

Available commands are:

approximate
assume ASSUMPTIONS
base BASE
clear
clear history
delete NAME
exact
expand
exrates
factor
find/list [NAME]
function NAME EXPRESSION
help [COMMAND]
history
info NAME
keep NAME

Press Enter to continue.MC/MS/M+/M- (memory operations)
mode
partial fraction
save/store NAME [CATEGORY] [TITLE]
save definitions
save mode
set OPTION VALUE
to/convert/-> UNIT or "TO" COMMAND
variable NAME EXPRESSION
quit/exit

Commands for RPN mode:
rpn STATE
stack
clear stack
copy [INDEX]
move INDEX 1 [INDEX 2]
pop [INDEX]
rotate [DIRECTION]
swap [INDEX 1] [INDEX 2]

Type help COMMAND for more information (example: help save).
Type info NAME for information about a function, variable, unit, or prefix
(example: info sin).
When a line begins with '/', the following text is always interpreted as a
command.

For more information about mathematical expression and different options, please
consult the man page, or the relevant sections in the manual of the graphical
user interface (available at https://qalculate.github.io/manual/index.html),
which also includes a complete list of functions, variables, and units.
